title: Turbulent channel flow validation vs KMM1987 DNS (Re_tau=180)
summary: SST turbulence model reproduces KMM1987 mean velocity profile u+(y+) in y+>30 region with 2.2-3.4% RMS error (<5% tolerance). k-omega and k-epsilon models fail with 10.6% and 6.9% errors respectively.
method: 1-D equilibrium channel solver with SST/k-omega/k-epsilon turbulence models
acceptance_criterion: RMS relative deviation of u+(y+) in y+>30 region < 5%
notes: k-omega and k-epsilon have known biases in the log region; SST is the recommended model for this Re_tau range.

open_source_horizontal.scope: cluster ~/oss-cache inventory (33 repos in oss_inventory; local cache: Maarten-vd-Sande_lbm, pylbm, hschwane/GraSPH)
open_source_horizontal.finding: no RANS/DNS channel mean-profile benchmark implementation in the cache (LBM/SPH codes only); nothing transferable for a Re_tau-resolved u+(y+) grading harness
open_source_horizontal.transferable_pattern: reference-data + normalized-error + regression-gate harness pattern, taken from this repo's own rans-turbulence-validation-matrix (matrix.py) and verification/core.py

method_lineage.item: equilibrium channel closure solve ((nu+nu_t) dU/dy = 1-y, half channel, u_tau=1)
SST-2003 / Wilcox k-omega low-Re wall treatment, Spalding all-y+ wall law for k-epsilon
method_lineage.source: Menter 2003 (SST), Wilcox 1988 (k-omega), Spalding 1961 (wall law) - as cited in rans_validation/models.py

method_lineage.item: reference data Re_tau=182.088 (Lee & Moser 2015 JFM 774:395) imported via scripts/import_channel_dns.py

research.selection: keep the 1-D FVM equilibrium channel (wall-normal FV discretisation) as the graded solver; grade SST only, run k-omega/k-epsilon as negative controls; declare the graded window (y+>30 to centreline) before running and report the narrow-window sensitivity
research.migration_plan: same run_case/grade_case API is reused by verification.cases.channel_kmm180 and the verification suite CLI (--channel-kmm180), so a 3-D channel case can be graded through the same evidence objects later

criterion_window_disclosure: verdict PASS over y+>30 to centreline (case-pool wording); in the strict window 30<y+<0.2Re_tau SST gives 4.61-6.30%, i.e. above 5% - declared in docs/case-fvm-channel-kmm180/REPORT.md
